source.directorySummary: Projects bottom-up indexes under a resolved root into validated parent/current/child projections, verifying source/summary/enrichment validity and coverage and formatting markdown/JSON with safe export and web preview support.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Adapts parsed CLI/web params into BottomupSummary calls, validates --path/--draft/--location constraints, encodes preview state, and routes to execute, format, or render web preview and save handlers.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Defines bottomup.summary and bottomup.summary.save subcommand schemas with options for path, root, format, parent/child depth, location, draft, and hidden web save state.

handler.test.ts.sourceSummary: Exercises bottom-up summary via temp workspaces to verify CLI/AI registration, parent/current/child rendering, staleness suppression, single-file filtering, JSON and draft hierarchical preview, safe export with workspace boundary checks, and web preview including legacy index compatibility.

handler.ts.sourceSummary: Reads .BOTTOMUP.json indexes under a resolved root, computes source/summary/enrichment validity and coverage, builds selected parent/current/child projection, and formats markdown/json or saves exports with workspace boundary checks.

types.ts.sourceSummary: Declares SummaryResolvedOptions, SummaryNodeView with relation/status/coverage/files, and SummaryProjection types for bottom-up summary views.

summary.value: Bottom-up summary command that projects indexes under a resolved root into validated parent/current/child projections, verifying source/summary/enrichment validity and coverage and formatting output as markdown/JSON with safe export and web preview support. Child renderers (complete) provides the web renderer for the preview modal, handling formatted content preview and save interaction; no missing or stale coverage indicated for this scope.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Read-side consumption surface for the bottom-up knowledge pipeline within plugins/file/commands — complements bottomup.generate/enrich (write/compute with hash-cache and draft lifecycle) by providing stateless projection and export of already-persisted .BOTTOMUP.json indexes. Operates as a dispatched leaf under the file plugin's centralized dispatcher (adapter.ts/handleFile) and init registration, reusing the commands container's workspace-root resolution and boundary validation but specializing in validated read-only views; delegates interactive web preview and save to its renderers child, isolating markdown/JSON formatting and modal presentation from index validity and coverage computation.

files.adapter.ts: Dispatch-facing adapter leaf in the file plugin's CLI/web fan-out — translates the container-wide validate-containment → execute → adapt pattern to summary-specific preview routing, enforcing --path/--draft/--location constraints and preview-state encoding before delegating to the pure projection handler.
files.definition.ts: Contract declaration for the bottomup.summary subcommand family within the 20-command registration — exposes projection controls (path/root/depth/format/location/draft) that define the slice boundary consumed by adapter and handler without owning execution logic.
files.handler.test.ts: Regression harness for the read/projection path — uses isolated temp workspaces to lock CLI/AI registration, parent/current/child projection, staleness filtering, single-file and JSON/draft rendering, safe export boundaries, and legacy index compatibility.
files.handler.ts: Pure projection engine for this directory — implements root resolution, index reading, validity/coverage computation, and markdown/json formatting/export independently of CLI/web transport, enabling reuse by both adapter execution and web preview handlers.
files.types.ts: Shared view-model contract for the projection layer — defines SummaryResolvedOptions/SummaryNodeView/SummaryProjection to decouple adapter, handler, and renderers from raw .BOTTOMUP.json shapes and to anchor relation/status/coverage semantics across parent/current/child views.
